data.content_ref: inline:Artifact 0bb6167c36cf reduces the 'emergent corrections' of SRC_001 to a byproduct of 'cognitive diversity variance' rather than a property of the checklist itself; it proposes that the reliability gain depends on the social dynamics of the panel rather than the tool's design. This is refuted if a single non-expert using the same checklist achieves the same rate of emergent corrections as the full panel.
